content:
Rumors have long suggested that Apple has been working on a major revamp of its Home lineup for years, and a new leak has provided a list of expected products.

macOS leak mentions multiple unreleased Home devices

Apple's biggest annual event is just weeks away. The new Home products are expected to be unveiled alongside the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone Ultra, and the next generation of Apple Watch models.

Rumors point to a new Apple TV 4K, HomePod mini 2, and the long-awaited HomePad. But there are also a few other Home products that may launch in the near future.

Yesterday, MacRumors spotted mentions of several unreleased products in the newly released macOS 26.7 RC.

Among them are codenames related to Home devices. According to Juli Clover:

  • HomePad (J490 and J491): "J490 is believed to be the dock-equipped version of the home hub, while J491 is designed for wall mounting."
  • HomePod mini 2 (B525): Since the HomePod mini's codename is B520, this is very likely the mini 2.
  • Home Accessory (J229): Very likely the rumored security camera product.
  • HomeAccessory17,2 and HomeAccessory17,3: Unknown Home devices appearing once again.
  • ATVRemote1,5: A new Siri Remote expected to launch alongside the next-generation Apple TV 4K.

Other Home products reportedly in development include a video doorbell and a desktop robotic home hub. It is currently unclear whether their codenames have appeared in the macOS 26.7 leak.

Beyond products, MacRumors also discovered a string named "Pebble," believed to be the codename for homeOS. There is also a string "audio_accessory_visual_reasoning," which may be related to the HomePad.

Finally, the leak also revealed four colors for an unspecified Home accessory: Rose Pink, Silver, Space Gray, and Starlight.
